description: This Java source file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableDefinitionIdentifier' that implements the 'DefinitionIdentifier' interface. It provides methods for creating, parsing, and comparing definition identifiers consisting of namespace, name, and version components. The class uses regex patterns for parsing string representations and ensures immutability of the identifier objects.
